question: The ________ is the site of the complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins and fats.
solution:
The correct answer is __**small intestine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** small intestine** is the site of the complete digestion of **carbohydrates, proteins and fats** because it is the** longest part** of the digestive system and has specialized structures called **villi and microvilli **that increase its **surface area for absorption.**
 
• **Carbohydrates **are broken down into simple sugars like** glucose**, **proteins** are broken down into **amino acids, **and **fats **are broken down into **fatty acids and glycerol **in the small intestine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** small intestine** is divided into three parts: **duodenum, jejunum and ileum, **with the duodenum being the first and shortest segment that receives** digestive enzymes** from the pancreas and** bile from the liver.**
 
• The** liver **is the **largest gland** in the body and performs many important functions, including **detoxifying harmful substances, storing vitamins and minerals,** and **producing blood-clotting proteins.**
 
• The large intestine is about **1.5 meters long** and has four main regions:** cecum, colon, rectum and anal canal**, with the colon being the longest part that is further divided into** ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid segments.**
 
• The food pipe is a muscular tube that is about **25 centimeters long** and has two sphincters, one at the upper end near the **throat **and one at the lower end near the **stomach**, that prevent food and **stomach acid** from flowing back.
